summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 3.7 Flash, claiming improved agentic performance and coding accuracy, demonstrated by a 3-agent team autonomously training a robotics control model.

practices.reason: The post states a capability gain in agentic performance and coding but gives no benchmark figures, so the claim is credible but unverified for our stack.
practices.quote: 3.7 Flash brings a big jump in agentic performance and coding accuracy.

practices.reason: A multi-agent setup that autonomously trained a robotics model is mentioned as a demo but with no architectural detail to implement from.
practices.quote: we set up a 3-agent team to autonomously train a robotics control model from scratch
